ctx.x: His brother was great with that. He had

a young brother that played in that band, and he was real great on this baritone horn. Because they -- and outside of that he was an outstanding reader. You had to read in that band. Because sometimes, if we couldn't get the idea of the phrase, he'd say, "Dunc, play that over for the fellows. Let them hear it," you know, and he'd go right through it, you know. He was beautiful with that.
